impact.text: Traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, will encounter unexplained failures.

precondition_sources.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.
The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21).

intent_sources.text: The zero-cost trade guard should trigger only when one side receives tokens without sending any, not merely when amounts have disjoint bits.
